_about: Michael's War Room rules (guillotine playbook; fantasy-rules.md rule 13 for the reserve). Change a number here and the next build uses it. reserve: dollars kept back while he is likely to survive. release_reserve_at_cut_risk: when the model's chance he is cut THIS week is at or above this (0.25 = 1 in 4; an average team now is about 1 in 9), a claim that lowers that chance by at least release_min_survival_gain (0.02 = 2 points) may spend the reserve; other claims never touch it. league_winners: players he has named worth big money; everyone else is capped at big_bid_share of his FAAB (at least big_bid_min). marginal_pts_per_week: a claim adding fewer lineup points a week than this (and any K or DEF) goes in at $0.
_about_handcuff: Fantasy rule 14 (Nov 14). base_miss: chance a starting RB misses any given week (Claude's estimate for a typical RB); tag_miss: this week's chance when he's tagged; as_starter_share: a handcuff's points as the starter when he has no 2+ weeks of filling in this season (share of the starter's projection); clear_margin and min_gap: a handcuff is dropped only when the add's lineup points over the season are at least clear_margin times his insurance AND min_gap points more (Nov 16: 2.5x and 8, up from 2x; Cousins at 10.5 vs 5.1 must not drop Braelon Allen); soon_weeks: the add must also help the lineup in at least one of the next soon_weeks weeks; the move must cost nothing this week; missing data means keep him (rule 12).
